description: The Educational career-field edition pack for the Sidewinder course: improvised teaching craft with what's on hand (no-tech lessons, classroom-made materials, lab and activity improvisation), career-skill entries for refining the educator's own craft (lesson and assessment design, questioning, feedback, differentiation, credential leveling, mentoring), and team-play entries for teaching as a team (co-teaching, grade-level huddles, lesson study, coverage systems, conflict repair, project weeks, onboarding). Every entry leads with mechanism diagnosis; every entry carries explicit stop conditions. Lawful only, no filler, terse.
notes_for_main_builder: Draft set of 42 entries; no schema.py exists yet so this manifest follows the coordinator's spec verbatim. Kind split: field how-tos (001-018) = improvised teaching craft; career-skill (019-032) = individual craft refinement; team-play (033-042) = team guidance. Prerequisites are pack-local. Kind metadata lives here in the manifest (kind_breakdown) since the entry schema has no kind field.
safety_posture: Student-safety first. No entry uses hazardous materials, violates student privacy (recording-policy checks are explicit where observation is involved), or substitutes for mandated safety/escalation protocols — behavior, conflict, and medical-adjacent entries carry hard stop conditions routing to admin, safety protocol, or professional support. Improvised classroom materials must be non-toxic, non-sharp, and allergen-checked.

track_emphasis.build: primary — improvised materials, routines, playbooks, exchange systems built from nothing
track_emphasis.combine: secondary — card-game math, co-teaching stations, interdisciplinary project weeks
track_emphasis.create: tertiary — anchor charts, rubrics, lesson designs authored fresh
track_emphasis.improve: primary — questioning, feedback, differentiation, data review, self-observation, lesson study
track_emphasis.improvise: primary — Sidewinder doctrine core: no-tech lessons, household-material demos, outdoor and pavement classrooms
track_emphasis.restore: tertiary — misconception repair, behavior repair conversations, team conflict repair
